snippet.title: NODE ZERO Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
NODE ZERO is a terminal-driven psychological horror game where every record, command, and system response could matter.

Assume the role of Operator 043, investigate system activity, trace failures, and complete a series of Proofs inside NEXUS—a client that becomes increasingly difficult to trust.

This is the official reveal trailer for NODE ZERO.

Wishlist NODE ZERO on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4937900/NODE_ZERO/

The free NODE ZERO demo launches July 24, 2026.

Visit the official Static State website:
https://www.staticstate.dev

Join the official Static State Discord:
https://discord.gg/aREP5kdmcA

Developed and published by Static State.
